protocol_type: AHCI is a register + system-memory programming model layered atop the Serial ATA Transport / Link / PHY layers (defined in Serial ATA 2.6). The on-wire protocol unit is the Frame Information Structure (FIS) — a Dword-aligned packet bracketed by SOF / EOF primitives, protected by a 32-bit CRC (polynomial 0x04C11DB7), 8b/10b encoded on the wire, separated from idle by ALIGN (0x7B4A4A7B) and CONT / SYNC primitives. The host-software protocol unit is the Command Header / Command Table / PRDT structure in system memory.

fis_format.framing: SOF primitive → FIS Dwords (FIS Type at byte 0) → 32-bit CRC → EOF primitive
fis_format.encoding: 8b/10b on the wire (defined in Serial ATA 2.6, not in AHCI)

fis_types.name: Register Host to Device (H2D)
fis_types.description: Carries ATA command + LBA + features + count; the Command FIS (CFIS) inside the Command Table is always an H2D Register FIS.

fis_types.name: Register Device to Host (D2H)
fis_types.description: Carries device Task File status / error / LBA / count; HBA copies into the RFIS area of the Received FIS Structure.

fis_types.name: DMA Activate
fis_types.description: Device tells HBA it is ready to receive a Data FIS (write command); HBA may auto-activate when CAP.SNCQ + NCQ is in use.

fis_types.name: DMA Setup
fis_types.description: Carries DMA buffer offset + transfer count + tag for first-party DMA / NCQ; HBA copies into the DSFIS area.

fis_types.name: Data
fis_types.description: Bulk data payload; gated by DMA Setup or DMA Activate.

fis_types.name: PIO Setup
fis_types.description: Carries Transfer Count + E_Status for a PIO data transfer; HBA copies into the PSFIS area.

fis_types.name: Set Device Bits
fis_types.description: Carries SActive update for NCQ completion (one bit per slot) + Error / Status updates; HBA copies into the SDBFIS area; PxSACT bits clear here.

primitive_symbols.name: ALIGN
primitive_symbols.purpose: Clock-rate compensation; sent during link initialization and as a fill primitive.

primitive_symbols.name: CONT
primitive_symbols.purpose: Indicates the following stream is a repeat of the previous primitive.

primitive_symbols.name: DMAT
primitive_symbols.purpose: DMA Terminate — host or device aborts a Data FIS in progress.

primitive_symbols.name: EOF
primitive_symbols.purpose: End-of-Frame; closes a FIS, follows the 32-bit CRC.

primitive_symbols.name: HOLD
primitive_symbols.purpose: Flow-control: transmitter has run out of data, asks receiver to wait.

primitive_symbols.name: R_OK
primitive_symbols.purpose: FIS received OK; mirror of CFIS completion → HBA may clear PxTFD.STS.BSY when Command Header C bit is set.

primitive_symbols.name: R_RDY
primitive_symbols.purpose: Receiver ready for a new FIS.

primitive_symbols.name: SYNC
primitive_symbols.purpose: Synchronization primitive; sent in the idle state.

primitive_symbols.name: WTRM
primitive_symbols.purpose: Wait Termination — sent after CRC + EOF to drain pipeline.

primitive_symbols.name: X_RDY
primitive_symbols.purpose: Transmitter ready to send a new FIS; precedes SOF.

oob_signaling_sequence.name: COMRESET
oob_signaling_sequence.description: Burst of 4 ALIGN primitives + idle period, repeated; resets the device's PHY. Initiated by software writing PxSCTL.DET = 1.

oob_signaling_sequence.name: COMINIT
oob_signaling_sequence.description: Device response burst; informs host the device is present and ready to begin link initialization.

oob_signaling_sequence.name: COMWAKE
oob_signaling_sequence.description: Host acknowledgment burst; initiates the speed-negotiation handshake.

oob_signaling_sequence.name: ALIGN-lock
oob_signaling_sequence.description: Bit-lock + word-lock established via repeated ALIGN primitives.

oob_signaling_sequence.name: speed-negotiation
oob_signaling_sequence.description: Host attempts highest speed it can support; device drops down until both agree. Gen 1 (1.5 Gbps) → Gen 2 (3 Gbps) → Gen 3 (6 Gbps).

fields_dw0.name: PRDTL
fields_dw0.description: Physical Region Descriptor Table Length in entries (0..65535).

fields_dw0.name: PMP
fields_dw0.description: Port Multiplier Port to which this command is directed; 0h for direct-attach.

fields_dw0.name: C
fields_dw0.description: Clear Busy upon R_OK: clear PxTFD.STS.BSY when CFIS transmits and R_OK is received.

fields_dw0.name: B
fields_dw0.description: BIST — command sends a BIST FIS and enters test mode.

fields_dw0.name: R
fields_dw0.description: Reset — command is part of software-reset sequence.

fields_dw0.name: P
fields_dw0.description: Prefetchable — HBA may prefetch PRDs / ATAPI command / data.

fields_dw0.name: W
fields_dw0.description: Write direction — 1 = system memory → device (write), 0 = device → system memory (read).

fields_dw0.name: A
fields_dw0.description: ATAPI — Command Table includes ACMD (12 / 16 B ATAPI command).

fields_dw0.name: CFL
fields_dw0.description: Command FIS Length in Dwords (2..16); values 0 and 1 are illegal.

fields_dw1.name: PRDBC
fields_dw1.description: Physical Region Descriptor Byte Count — running total of bytes transferred.

fields_dw3.name: CTBAU
fields_dw3.description: Command Table base address upper 32 b (S64A=1).

prd_entry_format.name: DBAU
prd_entry_format.description: Data Base Address Upper 32 b (only when S64A=1).

prd_entry_format.name: I
prd_entry_format.description: Interrupt on Completion — set PxIS.DPS when this PRD finishes.

prd_entry_format.name: DBC
prd_entry_format.description: Data Byte Count (zero-based, max 4 MB / entry); DBC[0]=1 for even byte count.

channels.name: TX (A+ / A-)
channels.description: Outbound differential pair; 8b/10b-encoded at the negotiated Gen 1/2/3 line rate.

channels.name: DEVSLP
channels.description: Sideband; HBA asserts to put device into DevSleep state (AHCI 1.3.1).

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no per-byte VALID/READY on the wire; framing is by SOF / EOF primitives + 32-bit CRC.
X_RDY (transmitter) ↔ R_RDY (receiver) primitive handshake gates each FIS start.
R_OK / R_ERR returned by receiver indicates per-FIS reception status.
HOLD / HOLDA primitive pair provides Dword-level flow control inside a Data FIS.
Software flow control at the AHCI level is the PxCI[slot] set→clear handshake; HBA clears PxCI[slot] on command completion.

frame_format.cfis: Command FIS — H2D Register FIS, up to 16 Dwords (64 B), embedded at Command Table offset 0x00.
frame_format.rfis: Received D2H Register FIS, 20 B, copied to RFIS region of Received FIS Structure at offset 0x40.
frame_format.data_fis: Data FIS — 1 Dword header (FIS Type = 0x46) + N Dwords payload up to 8 KB, transferred between system memory (PRD-described buffer) and device.
